facts.label: Day of March 2005 of the explosion
Height of the raffinate splitter tower, feet (170-foot tall tower)
The level transmitter measured only within the bottom this many feet of the tower
Actual liquid level in the tower at 1:04 p.m., feet
Minutes the three pressure relief valves stayed open
Minutes past the hour of the explosion (1:20 p.m.)

thumbnail.pattern: the niche's industrial-disaster covers show the plant at its moment of failure big with a few bold words; ours shows our 3D tower in cutaway with its liquid near the top beside the green gauge plate saying FALLING, under four words

beats.say: At BP's Texas City, this gauge says it's draining.

params.place: beside BP's raffinate splitter tower at the Texas City refinery under a grey sky, its shell cut away to glass

moments.what: the tall tower in cutaway, amber liquid already near its top and rippling, the date caption and the reconstruction tag; BP REFINERY types on
the camera drifts in over the unit, pipe racks and trailers behind
down to the level gauge at the tower's base glowing green, LEVEL GAUGE pinned to it; THE GAUGE SAYS FALLING lands in green with a down arrow
the FALLING readout's arrow blinks while the amber liquid shimmers above it
push up to the liquid surface near the top; an amber INSIDE ? plate lands under it

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.say: Inside, it's {fact5} feet high, in a tower {fact3} feet tall. Where does it go?

params.place: the same tower, the camera riding up its glass shell to the liquid's surface

moments.what: medium on the tower's lower half, the liquid level climbing past the trays
ride up the shell with the rising surface, REAL LEVEL pinned on it; the red LIQUID FEET plate lands
the red plate counts up to the real level
the TOWER FEET plate lands beside it
pull back wide to the whole tower, the liquid almost at its top, the plate counts the tower's height
the surface laps at the very top, just under the overhead pipe
the camera settles wide on the tower and its pipe

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.say: Why can't the board see it? Its gauge reads only the bottom {fact4} feet.

params.place: an engineer's cross-section of the tower on white drafting paper

moments.what: the tower's elevation draws on in black line, liquid shaded to its real level, REAL LEVEL marked
a blue arrow points to the gauge at the base, GAUGE
everything above the base is hatched red, NOT MEASURED types on
a blue bracket draws on over the short span at the bottom
push in on the base of the tower and the bracket
the span's height in feet is pinned beside the bracket

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.say: It overflows, down a pipe, through relief valves, for {fact6} minutes.

params.place: high on the tower top, then down the overhead pipe to the three red relief valves near the ground

moments.what: at the tower's top, the pipe begins to glow amber as liquid spills into it
the amber runs down the pipe along the tower's side
the camera follows it down the pipe
close on the three red relief valves popping open, RELIEF VALVES pinned; the VALVES OPEN MINUTES plate lands
pull out as the outlet line glows toward the drum, the plate counts the minutes

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.say: They feed an old vent stack with no flare. It erupts like a geyser.

params.place: the rusted blowdown drum and its tall open vent stack beside the unit

moments.what: wide on the rusted drum, glowing amber as it fills
the camera drifts up the old stack
VENT STACK pinned near its top
a red NO FLARE tag types on
push in on the stack top: liquid shoots up out of it
pull back as the geyser rains down round the drum as mist

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.say: Vapour drifts toward the contractors' trailers, and a pickup truck idling nearby.

params.place: high over the unit, then down at the row of contractor trailers and the idling pickup

moments.what: from high above, a pale vapour cloud spreads over the ground from the drum; FLAMMABLE VAPOUR types on
the cloud creeps wider across the gravel
down to the trailers, small figures of workers standing by their doors, TRAILERS pinned
close on the red pickup truck, exhaust puffing, IDLING TRUCK pinned
the vapour thins around its wheels

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.say: At {fact8} past {fact7}, it finds a spark.

params.place: low beside the idling pickup inside the vapour cloud

moments.what: the TIME plate lands with the clock time
the vapour swirls round the truck, the workers' trailers behind
the exhaust flickers
push in: a spark flashes at the engine

beats.speaker: narrator

params.place: the unit as the cloud ignites, then far back

moments.what: silence: the spark glowing at the engine in the cloud
the sub-boom: the whole cloud ignites, a white flash and a fireball
wide: the fireball and pressure ring roll over the trailers, debris flying

beats.say: {fact9} people died, all in or near those trailers.

params.place: the trailer area after the explosion, firefighters walking in

moments.what: the crushed trailers burning under smoke, firefighters with lamps walking in; the PEOPLE DIED plate lands
closer on the trailers, more firefighters arriving, IN OR NEAR THE TRAILERS types on

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.say: Gauge or trailers: which should have stopped it? Full story on our channel. It happened

params.place: back at the tower in the grey light, its liquid near the top again

moments.what: close on the amber surface near the top, THE GAUGE? types on in green
OR THE TRAILERS? types on in red
the liquid shimmers under the pipe
pull back wide to the whole tower, FULL STORY ON THE CHANNEL
the wide tower again, the same framing the video opens on

beats.speaker: narrator
